quote: 5 Stars – Highly Recommend! Margarida from Balga Designs is an absolute gem! She came and completely transformed my garden—from overgrown and messy to perfectly beautiful. Her attention to detail, creativity, and care really shine through in her work. It’s like a whole new space now, and I couldn’t be happier. Thank you, Margarida, for bringing your magic to my garden!
author: Chrystal Overton
